entities.name: Johannes von Tepl
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johannes von Tepl, also known as Johannes von Saaz, was a Bohemian writer of the German language, one of the earliest known writers of prose in Early New High German. He was literate in Czech, German, and Latin.
